H. קִימשׁ ; compare Baer De Complut.Var.28 ; || חוֺהַ ), Isa 34:13 (+ חוֺחַ סִירִים, ); plural (with נ insert, Thes Nö M 169, Anm.3 Löw 194Anm .) קִמְּשׂנִים Prov 24:31 (>van d. H. קִמְּשׁוֺנִים ; || חֲרֻלּים ). קֵן see קנן . קנא (√ of following; Arabic become intensely red (or black) , with dye; Late Hebrew קִנְאָה jealousy ; Syriac lividus fruit , zeal, envy (rare); verb denominative Late Hebrew קָנָא , Aramaic קְנָא , Ethiopic all be jealous, zealous ).
